about: Parker-Hannifin Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of motion and control technologies and systems for aerospace and defense, in-plant and industrial equipment, transportation, off-highway, energy, and HVAC and refrigeration markets in North America, EMEA, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. It operates through two segments: Diversified Industrial and Aerospace Systems.
